description: This file defines classes and data structures related to tensor sharding and distributed tensor specifications in PyTorch's distributed framework. It includes representations for shard ordering, tensor metadata, and specifications for distributed tensors (DTensorSpec), including methods for normalization, conversion, validation, and string formatting of sharding patterns.

classes.name: ShardOrderEntry
classes.description: Represents how a single tensor dimension is sharded across mesh dimensions, including the tensor dimension and the mesh dimensions it is sharded on.

classes.name: TensorMeta
classes.description: A simple named tuple to represent tensor metadata such as shape, stride, and dtype, used for sharding propagation.

classes.name: DTensorSpec
classes.description: A data class encapsulating the sharding spec for a distributed tensor, including mesh, placements, tensor metadata, shard order, and related methods for normalization, validation, conversion, and representation.

methods.name: None __post_init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes DTensorSpec, normalizing placements into shard order if not provided.

methods.name: tuple[tuple[Placement,...],ShardOrder|None] _normalize_placements_into_shard_order( placements: tuple[Placement, ...], mesh: DeviceMesh )
methods.description: Normalizes placements into a shard order, recombining _StridedShard placements if possible.

methods.name: ShardOrder compute_default_shard_order( placements: tuple[Placement, ...], )
methods.description: Computes the default shard order from placements, mapping tensor dims to mesh dims in order.

methods.name: tuple[Placement,...] _convert_shard_order_to_StridedShard( shard_order: ShardOrder, placements: tuple[Placement, ...], mesh: DeviceMesh )
methods.description: Converts a shard order into placements with _StridedShard for non-trivial shardings.

methods.name: ShardOrder|None _maybe_convert_StridedShard_to_shard_order( placements: tuple[Placement, ...], mesh: DeviceMesh )
methods.description: Attempts to reconstruct shard order from _StridedShard placements; returns None if not possible.

methods.name: None _verify_shard_order(self, shard_order: ShardOrder)
methods.description: Verifies that the provided shard order matches the actual placements.

methods.name: None __setattr__(self, attr: str, value: Any)
methods.description: Overrides attribute setting to verify shard order integrity and cache invalidation.

methods.name: int _hash_impl(self)
methods.description: Computes a hash of the DTensorSpec for caching purposes.

methods.name: int __hash__(self)
methods.description: Returns the cached or computed hash value.

methods.name: bool _check_equals(self, other: object, skip_shapes: bool = False)
methods.description: Checks equality with another DTensorSpec, optionally skipping shape comparison.

methods.name: bool __eq__(self, other: object, /)
methods.description: Equality comparison override.

methods.name: str __str__(self)
methods.description: Provides a human-readable string of the DTensorSpec, including dtype, shape, and sharding.

methods.name: bool is_default_device_order(shard_order: ShardOrder)
methods.description: Static method to check if shard order is the default left-to-right order.

methods.name: str format_shard_order_str( placements: tuple[Placement, ...], shard_order: ShardOrder | None = None, )
methods.description: Formats the shard order and placement info into a human-readable string.

methods.name: torch.Size shape(self)
methods.description: Returns the tensor shape from tensor_meta, raises if not set.

methods.name: tuple[int,...] stride(self)
methods.description: Returns the tensor stride from tensor_meta, raises if not set.

methods.name: int ndim(self)
methods.description: Returns the number of tensor dimensions.

methods.name: int num_shards(self)
methods.description: Calculates total number of shards across all sharded dimensions.

methods.name: DeviceMesh device_mesh(self)
methods.description: Returns the device mesh associated with this spec.

methods.name: list[int] dim_map(self)
methods.description: Returns a list mapping tensor dims to mesh dims, or -1 for replicate.

methods.name: list[int] num_shards_map(self)
methods.description: Returns a list of total shards per tensor dimension.

methods.name: list[int] sums(self)
methods.description: Returns list of mesh dims with pending partial sums.

methods.name: "DTensorSpec" from_dim_map( cls, mesh: DeviceMesh, dim_map: list[int], sums: list[int], tensor_meta: TensorMeta | None = None, )
methods.description: Constructs a DTensorSpec from a mesh, dim_map, sums, and optional tensor_meta.

methods.name: bool is_replicated(self)
methods.description: Checks if the tensor is fully replicated on all mesh dims.

methods.name: bool is_sharded(self)
methods.description: Checks if the tensor has any sharding.

methods.name: "DTensorSpec" shallow_copy_with_tensor_meta( self, tensor_meta: TensorMeta | None )
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy with a new tensor_meta.
